svg.title: Telemetry Pipeline (OpenTelemetry)
svg.desc: Telemetry Pipeline (OpenTelemetry). Receive, process and export traces, metrics and logs through one vendor-neutral collector. Step 1, One protocol in: Every service sends traces, metrics and logs over OTLP; one receiver feeds three pipelines. Step 2, Process in the middle: Processors tag each item, keep error traces plus 25% of the rest, strip personal data and batch. Step 3, Fan out: Each signal goes to its backend, and traces to two vendors at once: a config change, not code. Step 4, Stay up under pressure: The log store stalls: its queue fills and retries, then the memory limiter refuses new data.

g.text: Every service sends traces, metrics and logs over OTLP; one receiver feeds three pipelines.
Processors tag each item, keep error traces plus 25% of the rest, strip personal data and batch.
Each signal goes to its backend, and traces to two vendors at once: a config change, not code.
The log store stalls: its queue fills and retries, then the memory limiter refuses new data.
code imports only the OpenTelemetry API + SDK: no backend agent or library
every request is answered, so a sender can retry
sampling: every error trace + 25% of the rest
+ one exporter in the collector's config; no application is rebuilt
agents sit beside each workload: receive, tag, forward
gateways sample, redact and hold backend credentials
